resolution.reason: Schema now requires exactly five items and the loader compares the complete ordered seven-field declarations with the frozen canonical tuple; four, six, reordered, or drifted manifests are rejected by regression tests.

findings.title: Loader accepts fewer than the five frozen safeguards

resolution.reason: The loader now resolves and containment-checks both .ai/schemas and the exact mutation-manifest schema file before validation; repository-external schema symlinks fail with MUTATION_MANIFEST_PATH_ESCAPE and have a deterministic monkeypatch regression.

findings.title: Schema directory symlink can escape the repository

resolution.reason: The new schema_directory parameters were removed from public validate_contract and require_valid_contract APIs. Repository-bound validation uses a private helper only after loader containment checks; existing fixed-default callers remain compatible.

findings.title: Public contract APIs accept arbitrary schema directories

resolution.reason: Manifest JSON parsing now uses a duplicate-key rejecting object_pairs_hook; duplicate object keys fail deterministically with MUTATION_MANIFEST_READ_FAILED and a focused regression test.

findings.title: Duplicate JSON object keys are silently overwritten

summary: Implementation review blocks approval: the loader does not enforce the frozen exact five-entry manifest, repository-bound schema containment is incomplete, public contract validation was expanded to arbitrary schema directories, and duplicate JSON keys remain ambiguous.
